title: Hynek gave Spielberg alien drawings for Close Encounters

tellings.quote: collection of drawings very similar to these that date from actually back into the late 60s and early 70s that Dr. Alan Heinik uh handed to Spielberg to use uh for his special effects.

plain: The astronomer J. Allen Hynek is said to have given the director Steven Spielberg a set of drawings of alien beings, made in the late 1960s and early 1970s, which Spielberg used for the special effects of his 1977 film Close Encounters of the Third Kind. The researcher Budd Hopkins says this in a clip played on the show, without naming a source. He says the drawings were "very similar" to the ones he was showing. If true, the aliens in the film would be modeled on witness descriptions collected before it was made.
